Good morning. Before the doctor comes in, let me go through the instructions with you. You must not eat or drink anything after ten tonight. Water is fine until midnight, but nothing after that. You should take your usual blood pressure medication in the morning, with a very small amount of water. You do not have to stop the vitamins, but bring the box with you so we can check the list. If you feel any pain during the night, you can call this number at any time. And you must bring a family member with you tomorrow, because you will not be allowed to drive home.

So, let me summarize what we discussed. The results are not urgent, and you do not have to decide today. My recommendation is that you see a cardiologist before we schedule anything, because two of these numbers should be explained by a specialist, not by me. You might want to get a second opinion as well. That is not a problem, and honestly, in your position I would do the same. What you must not do is nothing at all. If the pain comes back at night, or if you feel it in your arm, you have to go to the emergency room immediately. That part is not negotiable.
